write_up: Your resume tells a coherent story: you moved from Mechanical Engineer I to Mechanical Engineer II at Westhaven, designing furniture components and now leading the Arlo desk platform. It's common for engineering resumes to list the work without saying how big it was or what came from it. Here, that makes it hard to stand out against other product design resumes, so a recruiter may finish and hesitate.

The supplier line is your best model: it names where the suppliers are and the tooling and inspection work you do with them. Your experience also comes before education, which puts your product work where a recruiter will see it first.
